summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held on August 28, 2026. Shareholders approved Proposals 1, 2, and 4 through 11, including amendments to the Articles of Association, but Proposal 3 (updated compensation policy) failed to receive required approval. The filing includes the amended Articles of Association. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The event is an ordinary shareholder meeting outcome, and no deal terms or strategic actions are disclosed.
